events.event: The IHSG ended the week of 2-6 November down 0.13% at 5,050.43, with market capitalisation down about Rp118 trillion and average daily trading value down 23%.
events.key_numbers: IHSG weekly -0.13% (5,057.05 -> 5,050.43) · market cap Rp8,862T -> Rp8,744T (-1.34%, about -Rp118T) · average daily transaction value Rp14.34T -> Rp11.04T (-23%) · foreign net sell YTD 2026 Rp98.08T · Friday 6 Nov foreign net buy Rp328.20bn · IHSG about -41.5% YTD per MediaKeuangan headline (unverified)
events.why_it_matters: After a 7% crash the week before, the index only held flat while trading dried up and foreigners have pulled nearly Rp100 trillion this year.
events.spreading_evidence: Weekly recap carried by Bisnis, Kontan, Okezone, Liputan6, IDN Times, MetroTV

events.event: Tapioca flour prices in West Java rose up to about 30% in recent months, squeezing cilok, cireng and gorengan sellers, while the Trade Ministry denied the 2025 import restriction is the cause.
events.key_numbers: Tapioca flour Rp10,000-14,000/kg -> Rp16,000-18,000/kg (up to ~30%) · farmgate cassava ~Rp700/kg -> ~Rp3,000/kg · DGFT Tommy Andana denies import-restriction (lartas) link · coordination meeting under Kemenko Pangan also covers 2027 cassava/tapioca balance · Agriculture Minister Amran links complaints to planned cassava exports
events.why_it_matters: The flour behind street snacks like cilok and gorengan is getting pricier, and the government is blaming weather and exports rather than its own import curbs.
events.spreading_evidence: detikFinance terpopuler #3; Kompas.id, Republika, Pikiran Rakyat coverage

events.event: Details of the fourth DHE SDA revision emerged: more destination countries are relaxed, one more bank is added as a placement bank, and the conversion cap would rise from 50% to up to 100%.
events.key_numbers: Placement banks total 16 (5 BUMN + 11 non-BUMN), PT Bank OCBC NISP added · relaxation extended to South Korea, Japan and EU (previously US, Canada, China incl. Hong Kong, Australia; rakortas 3 Nov 2026) · conversion cap 50% -> up to 100% · rule targeted to finish end-November · conversion to rupiah down 37.4% per LNSW head Oza Olavia · detik says 'five countries' but lists fewer (unverified)
events.why_it_matters: The government is loosening its own rule on exporters' dollars to pull more of them into rupiah while the currency sits near record lows.
events.spreading_evidence: Several detikFinance items on DHE on 6-7 Nov; 'Revisi Keempat DHE' headline on detik feed

events.event: Coordinating Minister Airlangga Hartarto said the alleged illegal wiretapping of President Prabowo could weigh on market sentiment and investment.
events.key_numbers: No market figures cited in the headlines · context: IHSG closed 5,050.43 on 6 Nov, rupiah Rp18,080/USD
events.why_it_matters: A minister is openly tying a police wiretapping scandal to market confidence at a time when stocks and the rupiah are already fragile.
events.spreading_evidence: Reported by 8+ outlets in search; detikFinance feed 10 hours before fetch

events.event: Brent crude traded near US$97.7 a barrel on 6 November, well below the US$115.81 recorded on 26 October.
events.key_numbers: Brent (Jan 2027) US$97.69, previous close US$98.29 · WTI US$90.27 (prev US$90.52) · Brent 26 Oct US$115.81 (E0383) · Pertamina Pertamax Rp15,950, Pertalite Rp10,000, Biosolar Rp6,800 unchanged since 2 Sep; 1 Nov review kept prices · Pertalite/Biosolar will not rise through end-2026 per government
events.why_it_matters: Cheaper oil eases pressure on fuel prices and the rupiah, though Pertamax and private SPBU prices have not moved yet.
